title: Apply the /u/ user-URI rule (.6.76) at the remaining user-URI sites
description: Follow-up to decision mimid-1wgh.6.76. Local-user sites that still check only the domain (identity_domain): follower/consent.rs:156 (consent local URI), follower/identifier.rs:100 (identifierQuery), follower/key_packages.rs:307 (keyMaterial targetUser), http.rs:169 (keyMaterial hub-vs-follower routing). All look users up in the client table, whose new rows only come from a LocalUser upload, so they already refuse non-user URIs for data written after .6.76; tightening matters only for pre-existing rows. Each is a switch to hub::user_uri_domain; failing-first tests need hand-encoded consent and signed keyMaterial fixtures. Separate question for Mark (remote users): consent.rs:159, hub/key_material.rs:107,134, hub/update.rs:421,461,672-673 check remote URIs by domain only; applying the rule in hub/update.rs would also refuse the hub's own mimi://<domain> identity as a sender, which needs its own decision.
notes: 2026-11-04: local-user sites done (consent 404, identifierQuery notFound, keyMaterial noConsent on both routes; routing unchanged by design — see worker report). Remote-user question still open for Mark: consent.rs remote URI, hub/key_material.rs:107,134, hub/update.rs:421,461,672-673.
